description: This file contains implementation of RRC (Radio Resource Control) message handlers for a UE (User Equipment) in a 5G NR (New Radio) network. It includes functions for processing various RRC messages such as setup, reestablishment, resume, handover, and security procedures, as well as packing and unpacking ASN.1 encoded messages, managing UE context, and coordinating with other network components.

classes.name: rrc_ue_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for handling RRC messages and procedures for a UE in 5G NR.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_pdu
methods.description: Handles uplink CCCH PDU, parses ASN.1 message, and dispatches to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: handle_rrc_setup_request
methods.description: Processes RRC Setup Request, performs validation, and initiates RRC setup procedure.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reest_request
methods.description: Handles RRC Reestablishment Request, validates, and starts reestablishment procedure.

methods.name: handle_rrc_resume_request
methods.description: Processes RRC Resume Request, falls back to RRC setup if necessary, or initiates resume procedure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing transactions in the event manager.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles downlink DCCH PDU, parses ASN.1 message, and dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: handle_ul_dcch_pdu
methods.description: Processes UL-DCCH PDU, unpacks PDCP PDU, and handles contained RRC messages.

methods.name: handle_security_mode_complete
methods.description: Configures security for SRB1 upon receiving Security Mode Complete message.

methods.name: handle_ul_info_transfer
methods.description: Handles UL NAS transport message, forwards to NGAP, or releases UE if invalid.

methods.name: handle_measurement_report
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 measurement report and forwards to measurement notifier.

methods.name: handle_dl_nas_transport_message
methods.description: Handles downlink NAS message, stores if UE inactive, or sends via DL-DCCH.

methods.name: handle_rrc_transaction_complete
methods.description: Completes RRC transaction and resumes suspended procedures.

methods.name: get_security_mode_command_context
methods.description: Prepares and packs Security Mode Command message, initiates security procedures.

methods.name: handle_security_mode_complete_expected
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for Security Mode Complete, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: get_packed_ue_capability_rat_container_list
methods.description: Serializes UE capability list into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: get_packed_ue_radio_access_cap_info
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 message for UE radio access capabilities.

methods.name: handle_rrc_handover_preparation_info
methods.description: Unpacks handover preparation info and stores UE capabilities.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Starts RRC reconfiguration procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_handover_reconfiguration_context
methods.description: Builds handover reconfiguration message, either plain ASN.1 or wrapped with PDCP.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_cond_reconfiguration_context
methods.description: Builds conditional reconfiguration message with measurement configs and CHO candidates.

methods.name: get_transfer_context
methods.description: Gathers UE transfer context including security, measurement, and capabilities.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Provides UE reestablishment context including security, capabilities, and state.

methods.name: get_rrc_handover_command
methods.description: Creates RRC Handover Command message with reconfiguration details.

methods.name: handle_rrc_handover_command
methods.description: Unpacks Handover Command, extracts reconfiguration, and packs for transmission.

methods.name: store_ue_capabilities
methods.description: Unpacks and stores UE capabilities ASN.1 data.

methods.name: handle_rrc_ue_capability_transfer_request
methods.description: Starts UE capability transfer procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_release_context
methods.description: Prepares RRC release message, either RRCReject or RRCRelease, with optional inactivity info.
